verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot documents isolated cloud and local sandbox environments for its agent to safely execute code/tools/filesystem/network operations separate from production (github-copilot-docs-16), which supports agentic testing without touching production data. However, there's no explicit mention of sandbox environments mirroring production data or test-data provisioning workflows, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific sandbox-vs-production separation in the community evidence. Missing for 10: independent verification of sandbox isolation in practice, documentation on how production data is excluded/masked in sandbox runs, and details on data provisioning for realistic testing.
